answer_1.quote: We also propose a generative model Bi-Phone that is able to synthetically produce spelling corruption in accordance with L1-L2 confusions

answer_2.quote: We can compute the coverage of Bi-Phone in web data by considering the fraction of sentences where the misspelling confidence score is greater than a certain threshold over the total number of sentences in our original pool

answer_4.quote: For each language, we present 150 randomly selected word, misspelling pairs generated from Bi-Phone to native speakers... Each rater provides a 1 or 0 to indicate whether the variant looks plausible or not
answer_4.guideline: evaluate if the misspelling is plausible for pronunciation shifts often made by speakers of the given first language
